title_en: Coastal Insurance with Solvency, Affordability, and Heritage Constraints
title_zh: 沿海保险：偿付、可负担性与遗产保护约束
assessment_en: Uncalibrated author-external AI opinion: Meritorious-centered, adjacent Honorable Mention–Finalist; the current paper did not receive a new holistic award assessment.
assessment_zh: 作者外 AI 未校准参考意见：Meritorious 中心，相邻档为 Honorable Mention–Finalist；当前稿未重新进行完整奖档评估。
strength_en: Connects annual underwriting, post-claim capital, renewal fees, development NPV and heritage protection; independently checks finite funding paths and dependence bounds while retaining rejected scenarios.
strength_zh: 把年度承保、灾后资本、续期费用、开发净现值与遗产保护连成决策链；独立检查有限资金路径和任意依赖下的风险界，保留真实拒绝情景。
limits_en: Engineering, losses, demand, capital providers and fees require real verification. The EUR 207,781 fee-inclusive renewal quote fails the original EUR 200,000 annual budget; EUR 208,000 is an unapproved alternative, requiring an additional EUR 1.4775 m in outside three-year capital. Three years of funding cannot secure thirty-year renewal. Complete formal original AI logs are unavailable.
limits_zh: 工程、损失、需求、资金提供者与费用均须实际核实。含 2% 续期资金费用的 EUR 207,781 报价超出原 EUR 200,000 年预算；EUR 208,000 是待批准替代方案，并另需 EUR 1.4775 m 三年外部资本。三年资金不能保证三十年续期；正式完整 AI 原日志未知。
review_scope_en: Author-external AI read the preceding complete 22-page scientific manuscript and independently checked funding paths, risk bounds and NPV. Final review covered source changes, the 27-row risk explanation and actual layouts on pages 16–20 and 22. No model or 38 author-check rerun; the coordinator separately viewed all 22 current pages.
review_scope_zh: 作者外 AI 全读前一 22 页科学稿并独立检查资金路径、风险界与净现值；最终源码差异、27 行风险解释及第 16–20、22 页实际增量查看。不重跑模型或 38 项作者检查；协调者另查看当前全部 22 页。
reviewer_identity_en: Author-external AI review with follow-up by the same reviewer; neither human nor technically blind. Exact served model identity is unknown.
reviewer_identity_zh: 作者外 AI 评阅，同一评阅者复核；非真人或技术盲审。确切实际模型身份未知。
